_comment: The club's weekly meetings. This is the only place the day, time, venue and address of a regular club night are written: assets/calendar.js draws them, the Events Calendar page builds its .ics downloads from them, scripts/generate-meeting-schema.mjs writes the recurring Event structured data from them, and scripts/check-meetings.mjs checks that index.html and faq.html still say the same thing. See README section 9.
